## Bio
I am a PhD candidate in psychometrics at the University of Groningen. My research focuses on item response theory, computerized adaptive testing, and statistical methods in psychology and related fields. I also teach statistics and R at the Faculty of Behavioural and Social Sciences.

I studied health sciences in Munich and psychology in Groningen, followed by a research master's in psychometrics and statistics.

I welcome contact from researchers interested in collaborating on the topics below, and on psychometrics more broadly.

{{< include _content/research.qmd >}}

## Research Interests

My research interests are broad and center on:

-   Item Response Theory and Response Time Modeling
-   Computerized Adaptive Testing
-   Bayesian Inference
-   Application of machine learning methods

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# Returns the first entry in a content file, so the home page always shows the
# newest item. With `heading`, it starts looking below that heading.
# Keep the newest entry first in each list.
first_entry <- function(file, heading = NULL) {
  lines <- trimws(readLines(file, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"))
  start <- if (is.null(heading)) 0 else which(lines == heading)[1]
  if (is.na(start) || start >= length(lines)) return(NULL)
  rest <- lines[(start + 1):length(lines)]
  rest <- rest[!startsWith(rest, ":::")]
  first <- which(nzchar(rest))[1]
  if (is.na(first) || startsWith(rest[first], "#")) return(NULL)
  rest <- rest[first:length(rest)]
  end <- which(!nzchar(rest) | startsWith(rest, "#"))[1]
  entry <- if (is.na(end)) rest else rest[seq_len(end - 1)]
  paste(sub("\\\\$", "", entry), collapse = " ")
}

pub  <- first_entry("_content/publications.qmd", "## Journal Articles")
talk <- first_entry("_content/presentations.qmd")

cat("::: hanging-indent\n")
if (!is.null(pub)) {
  cat("**Latest publication** · [all publications](publications.qmd)\\\n", pub, "\n\n", sep = "")
}
if (!is.null(talk)) {
  cat("**Latest presentation** · [all presentations](presentations.qmd)\\\n", talk, "\n\n", sep = "")
}
cat(":::\n")
```
